name: Kyou mo Dare ka ni Dakareru Kanojo ~ Ai Suru Koibito no Himitsu no Shigoto
original_name: 今日も誰かに抱かれる彼女　～愛する恋人の秘密の仕事
source:
The protagonist has a childhood friend who grows up together with him named Kougami Yukimi. Although he has feelings for her, he never confesses, and then, Yukimi passes the entrance exam first and moves to the city.

A year later, he passes the exam as well, moves to Tokyo, and reunites with Yukimi. He then confesses his feelings, which he has been harbouring for over a year, and asks to go out with her. However, she refuses, telling him that even though she likes him, she cannot go out with him. When asking for the reason, Yukimi becomes reticent and does not give him a clear answer.

Nevertheless, he does not give up and continues to persuade her, and then, Yukimi suddenly asks him to have sex with her. Even though he is confused, he loses to his emotions and desires, and embraces her, but becomes confused even more, when he feels that Yukimi is experienced in blowjob and the cowgirl position.

After the act, Yukimi confesses that she has already had sex before and is no longer a virgin. Although he is shocked by the fact, he still asks her to go out with him, but she withholds the answer. Afterwards, their days of intimacy continue, and the protagonist assumes that they are already lovers.

Meanwhile, no, even before that, without the protagonist knowing, Yukimi has been doing a certain "job". And it is――

translation:
主角有一位一起长大的青梅竹马，名叫鸿上由纪美。虽然一直喜欢她，却始终没有表白。后来，由纪美先一步通过升学考试，搬到了城里。

一年后，主角也顺利考上，来到东京，与由纪美重逢。他向她倾诉了埋藏一年多的心意，请求与她交往。然而，她却拒绝了，告诉他，自己虽然也喜欢他，却不能和他在一起。问及理由，由纪美便沉默下来，始终没有明确回答。

主角没有放弃，继续试着说服她。就在这时，由纪美却突然提出要和他发生关系。他虽然困惑，最终还是被感情与欲望驱使，抱住了她。可由纪美在口交与女上位时表现得十分熟练，又让他愈发不解。

事后，由纪美坦言，自己过去已有性经验，不再是处女。主角虽然震惊，仍然提出与她交往，但她依旧没有答复。此后，两人亲密相处的日子持续着，主角也以为，他们已经是恋人了。

与此同时——不，早在那之前，在主角毫不知情的情况下，由纪美就已经开始从事某种“工作”。而那份工作是——
